test_title: PYST 41: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 01 Sept, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹4,000 at 6.75% per annum rate of interest deposited on 24 February 2024 and withdrawn on 25 April 2024.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹4,000

Rate of interest (R) = 6.75% per annum

Time (T) = From 24 February 2024 to 25 April 2024 = 2 months and 1 day

Time in years = (2 × 30 + 1) ÷ 365 = 61 ÷ 365

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ T = 61 ÷ 365 = 0.1671 years

⇒ SI = (4,000 × 6.75 × 0.1671) ÷ 100

⇒ SI = (4,522.2) ÷ 100

⇒ SI = ₹45.22

⇒ Rounded to ₹45

**∴ The correct answer is ₹45.**
